## Our focus

DNA methylation can influence gene regulation without changing the DNA sequence. This project examines how methylation patterns relate to inflammation, disease phenotype, and potential biomarkers in colitis. The website is the group's living research notebook: work is shared early, reviewed together, and improved over time.

::: {.callout-note title="This site is under active development"}
The current content is a starter structure. Study aims, datasets, ethics information, and validated findings should be added by the research team before public release.
:::
:::
